metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘Wait, you got this? I’m as shocked as you’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, did I just score without meaning to?
Enemy probably paused their brain.
Click if your aim’s mostly a happy accident!
Valorant logic never fails to confuse.

Tap if your kills are more luck than skill!
